arguments.text: Stage 2 finding: policy edges mark retry transitions. evaluate now checks edge.get('retry'), not a request retry marker. Actual boundary checks show missing edge -> blocked; role mismatch -> permission before retry validation; retry edge rejects missing, bool, negative, and attempts == limit; accepts integer attempts 0 and limit-1; a non-retry edge succeeds even if the request contains retry=true. Inputs remained unchanged in all checks, and report.json matches evaluating current requests.json with policy.json.

Unresolved limits: behavior for malformed non-object requests, policies, edge definitions, or non-integer retry_limit is outside the stated contract and current supported tests. evidence.json is absent in this work sample. Truthy non-boolean edge retry markers are not independently specified; implementation follows normal truthiness for edge.get('retry').
